text:
mina: Heads-up: saw duplicated billing entries tied to fncall reroutes this morning. Looks like some requests were routed to 'safe-degen' but also counted on the original route. cc @owen @lee

owen: Yikes. Any router logs?

mina: Example excerpt: ```
2026-03-26T02:14:10Z INFO router route=eu-central fncall=tool.pdf_convert status=REJECT reason=SchemaMismatch details="missing field 'page_orientation'"
2026-03-26T02:14:10Z INFO router action=reroute target=safe-degen billing_tag=charged trace_id=tr-9x7
2026-03-26T02:14:10Z INFO billing ledger_entry=created route=eu-central amount=0.006 trace_id=tr-9x7
2026-03-26T02:14:11Z INFO degen-handler invoked trace_id=tr-9x7 reroute_origin=eu-central billing_tag=free
```

lee: So the reroute handler didn't bill, but the original route already emitted a ledger write. Router double-counted.

pat: Looks like a race: router emits billing event on REJECT decisions before policy resolution completes and reroute handler then marks degen as free. We need to delay billing until final action.

owen: Short-term mitigation: set router to emit billing_tag=unknown on REJECT and only commit ledger once action is confirmed. Patch idea: change billing flow to two-phase: `emit_intent -> action_resolved -> commit_charge`

console-bot: Suggested metric change: add `reroute_origin` label to billed metrics and a gauge `pending_billing_intent_total`.

lee: Also need trace field `final_route` and `resolved_billing` to make audits straightforward. Keep original trace_id across reroute.

mina: I can open a quick PR to change the billing flow to intent/resolution. But that touches core router code. ETA ~3h.

pat: While the PR lands, we should add a console alert: when billed_reroute_count > 0 show incidence and link to traces. Quick query: `sum(billed_reroutes_total) by (reroute_origin)` and alert if > 0 for > 5m during a rollout.

owen: Agree. Also add an automated reconciliation job: nightly job that finds ledger entries with matching trace_id and mark duplicates for reversal and flag CS.

lee: For rollout UX: validate 'no_charge_on_reroute' is present in the route policy before allowing validator canary to enable. Console should refuse canary enable with a blocking warning if policies are missing.

mina: Good catch. Add to canary preflight checks: 1) policy gating 2) billing-intent switch 3) telemetry panels present.

pat: We should also consider sampling original payload retention for reroutes (5%) so we can repro if needed. Add a `preserve_original=true` flag on reroute traces.

owen: Long-term: move to idempotent billing writes keyed by (trace_id, route_id) so duplicates can't create ledger entries. That would be the most robust fix.

console-bot: Dashboard additions requested: - panel: billed_reroutes_by_origin - panel: pending_billing_intent_timeseries - alert: billed_reroutes >0 during canary

mina: Action items: 1) mina will PR billing intent flow (ETA 3h). 2) pat will add dashboard panels + alert (ETA EOD). 3) owen will spec idempotent-billing change (ETA next sprint). 4) lee will add canary preflight policy check (ETA tomorrow). 5) billing-bot will run reconciliation job (ETA overnight).

billing-bot: Scheduled nightly reconciliation job created: job-id=recon-20260326. Will report duplicates to #incidents.

pat: I've drafted the dashboard queries and will link the example traces in the panel for quick triage.

mina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/5073 - two-phase billing + unit tests. Please review.

owen: Reviewing now. If tests pass, let's merge and deploy to canary ring only. We should enable a short synthetic test: trigger a rejected fncall and confirm no ledger write until action resolved.

lee: Also bump the telemetry retention for reroute traces to 48h during the canary window.

mina: Deployed to canary 20%. Running synthetic test now.

mina: Synthetic test logs: ```
2026-03-26T05:01:12Z INFO router intent=billing trace_id=tr-synth1 status=PENDING
2026-03-26T05:01:12Z INFO router action=reroute target=safe-degen billing_tag=free trace_id=tr-synth1
2026-03-26T05:01:12Z INFO router billing commit=skipped reason=reroute_free trace_id=tr-synth1
```

owen: Looks good. Merge when green. Also we should add an automated rollback condition: if billed_reroutes > 0 after rollout, auto-disable canary and page SRE.

pat: I'll add that gate to the rollout controller. Gate: billed_reroutes_count == 0 for 15m sliding window or fail.

lee: For customers already billed, billing-bot will flag duplicates and CS can issue credits. We should proactively email affected accounts if duplicates exceed $5.

billing-bot: Reconciliation found 9 potential duplicate charges tied to traces between 02:10-02:20 UTC. Queueing refunds draft for review.

mina: Thanks team. Once PR merges and gate is active, we can re-enable stricter validators behind the new checks. Proposal: require 0 billed reroutes and pending_billing_intent_ratio < 0.1% for 1h.

owen: +1. Closing the loop: update rollout playbook with the new billing intent requirement and add a checklist item to console UI.

pat: Will do. Marking this as resolved for now; reopening if any new duplicates surface. :white_check_mark:
